ios.desc:
Cloxee is a free app for creating personalized countdowns and widgets to keep track of the dates that matter most.

You can create a countdown for birthdays, vacations, anniversaries, concerts, parties, special occasions, and any other important event. Customize each countdown by choosing from different styles, fonts, and filters, then add your own photo or pick one from the gallery.

With Cloxee, you can also display your countdown as a widget, so you can check in real time how much time is left until your event directly from your device screen.

Customize every countdown
Make each event unique with your own style. Choose the design you like best, change fonts and filters, and add a personal image or a background that fits the occasion.

Keep track of the dates that matter
Cloxee is perfect for following all the most important events in your life:

birthdays
vacations
anniversaries
concerts
parties
weddings
special occasions
important appointments

Countdown in days, hours, minutes, and seconds
Not just days: Cloxee lets you track the time left until a specific date or time, showing days, hours, minutes, and seconds in real time.

Widgets always visible
One of Cloxee’s best features is the ability to use your countdowns as widgets. This way, you can always keep an eye on the time left without opening the app every time.

Share your countdowns
Your countdowns can be easily shared and saved on your device, so you can show them to friends and family or use them to promote a special event.

Whether you are waiting for your birthday, a trip, a concert, or an important date you do not want to forget, Cloxee helps you enjoy the anticipation in a simple, beautiful, and always visible way.
